task1.title: Requesting a Refund
task1.prompt: You recently purchased a pair of shoes online, but they were the wrong size. Write a letter to the customer service department of the company. In your letter, you should: 1. Describe the problem with the shoes. 2. Explain how this has affected you. 3. Request a refund or the correct size.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In today's world, technology has transformed the way we communicate with each other. Some people believe that this change has improved the quality of communication, while others argue that it has led to a decline in face-to-face interactions. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on the matter. Provide examples to support your arguments.
